reader_summary.headline: Brett Barth and Evan Roth are co-founders and Co-CEOs of BBR Partners.
reader_summary.overview: Brett Barth and Evan Roth are co-founders and Co-CEOs of BBR Partners. Brett appeared on episode 3 of Capital Allocators eight years ago and is a regular contributor in our Friends Reunion shows. I've observed BBR's growth since first meeting Brett and Evan twenty-four years ago and was excited to hear more about their journey.

key_points.text: Brett Barth and Evan Roth are co-founders and Co-CEOs of BBR Partners.
Our conversation covers BBR's successes, missteps, and key lessons over the years.
We discuss their investment philosophy and cultural principles, the "turbulent regimes" that cemented their approach with clients.
